ValidationRule.description: Ensures the selected City matches the Region. City must be within the region.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Region__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(City__c))), OR( AND(TEXT(Region__c) = "India", NOT(OR(TEXT(City__c)="Bangalore", TEXT(City__c)="Delhi", TEXT(City__c)="Jaipur", TEXT(City__c)="Mumbai"))), AND(TEXT(Region__c) = "Netherlands", NOT(OR(TEXT(City__c)="Amsterdam", TEXT(City__c)="Rotterdam"))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invalid Region-City combination. Please select a city that belongs to the selected region. India: Bangalore, Delhi, Jaipur, Mumbai | Netherlands: Amsterdam, Rotterdam
